lines.en: I move forward keeping time.

lines.zh: 我的袍角扫过源石碎屑。
lines.en: My robe sweeps through originium debris.
Every step lands on the beat.
I hum quietly as I walk.

lines.zh: 源石在我靴下发出脆响。
lines.en: Originium crackles under my boots.
I circle this clearing.

lines.zh: 我的影子跟着歌声起伏。
lines.en: My shadow rises and falls with the song.
Chin raised, I walk straighter.
I cross the rubble without a stumble.
I walk toward wherever there is an echo.

lines.zh: 我的手指在空气里打着拍。
lines.en: My fingers beat time in the air.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕着它转了一圈。
lines.en: I take one slow turn around it.
I stand, and something trembles in my throat.
The song has never stopped.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，像在指挥。
lines.en: I raise a hand as if conducting.
Originium debris vibrates at my feet.
I save this breath for a song.
This song grows longer and longer.
I lower my head and listen to the echo.

lines.zh: 我的歌声里有源石的味道。
lines.en: My song tastes of originium.

lines.zh: 我戴着面具，谁也看不见我。
lines.en: I wear a mask; no one sees me.
My song has no words.
My song is about originium.

lines.zh: 我的歌不是唱给你听的。
lines.en: My song is not sung for you.

lines.zh: 你站在这儿，拍子就乱了。
lines.en: Standing there, you break the rhythm.
There is originium in the earth under you.
I am singing a very old song.
You carry no notes at all.
I raise a hand, and you take half a step back.
The third verse is hard to endure.

lines.zh: 你听见的不是我在说话。
lines.en: What you hear is not me speaking.
I leave this passage for you.
My song broke off for a moment.
A crack has opened in my mask.
I step back and my pitch drops.
Originium dust settles on my robes.
I clasp my throat and release it.
I have noted this passage.
My breathing has grown rough.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站直，把音拉回去。
lines.en: I straighten and pull the note back.
You have broken the harmony.
The song must go on.
You have handed that into the song.
I do not eat. I only sing.
That smell ruins the harmony.
Hold it up and let me look.
I reach out and do not take it.
Set it down and do not block the score.
Your offering is too noisy.
That mouthful will not buy a verse.

lines.zh: 我看了看，又转身唱起来。
lines.en: I glance at it, then turn back to singing.
Keep it; I have no use.
Your shoulder interrupted the beat.
I step back, and the song goes on.
We raise a cloud of originium dust.
The bump put me half a note off.
You stumbled into my robes.
I steady you with a light touch.
This moment is a rest.
We part and go our ways.
The echo lingers on the ground.
Do not tread on my hem.

lines.zh: 你想跟着这个拍子唱吗？
lines.en: Will you sing to this beat?
Two voices will carry farther.
Take up this passage after me.
One high, one low. Just right.
The originium will remember this melody.
At the end, we stop.
You sing off key, but with force.
We circle the clearing three times.

lines.zh: 这首歌现在有了第二段。
lines.en: The song has a second part now.
Do not stop; stopping breaks it.
I lift it between my fingertips.
This thing is vibrating.

lines.zh: 我把它举到耳边听了听。
lines.en: I raise it to my ear and listen.
It hums in my hand.
I lay it on the music stand.
The originium brushed against it.
I draw it into my sleeve, quietly.
Its weight is like a brief rest.
Did you drop it? Take it.

lines.zh: 我把它放回原处，台上的歌还没唱完。
lines.en: I put it back; the song on stage is unfinished.

lines.zh: 你成了这首歌的一部分。
lines.en: You have become part of the song.
The third verse begins now.

lines.zh: 我在你身上找到了拍子。
lines.en: I have found the beat in you.
Do not move; it goes off key.

lines.zh: 源石在跟着我的声音涨。
lines.en: The originium swells with my voice.
Listen — the debris on the ground is moving.
This passage has no rests.

lines.zh: 歌者的嗓子，是源石做的。
lines.en: The singer's throat is originium.
My song will reach you first.
This half is for you.
You have already begun to sway.
Do not cover your ears; it will not help.
I raise both hands, and the song begins.
Now — sing along with me.
This clearing is the stage.
The curtain falls after the last verse.
I hum a tune as I close in.
The sound comes from every side at once.
Listen long enough and your head will nod.
I have lowered the pitch.
The originium under your feet begins to ring.

lines.zh: 我等你的呼吸合上拍子。
lines.en: I wait for your breathing to match the beat.
You retreat, but the sound does not.
I count how many verses you have left.

lines.zh: 你听得见自己的心跳吗？
lines.en: Can you hear your own heartbeat?
This song has no other exit.

lines.zh: 我把重音都放在了后半。
lines.en: I have put the accents in the second half.
This verse is just for you.
My shadow keeps time for you.

lines.zh: 你身后的回音比你先动。
lines.en: The echo behind you moves before you do.
The last verse will speed up.
Do not blink; you will miss the turn.
My voice is beginning to overlap itself.
You are still standing there, off key.

lines.zh: 现在只剩我们两个声部。
lines.en: Only two voices remain now.

lines.zh: 这一拍落下来，就结束了。
lines.en: When this beat falls, it ends.
I press my voice to its lowest.

lines.zh: 我每一步都踩在源石碎屑上。
lines.en: Every step of mine lands on originium shards.

lines.zh: 源石碎屑从地上浮起来。
lines.en: Originium debris lifts off the ground.
That note sounds like someone weeping.
I sweep with my robe's sleeve.
You cover your ears and fall back.
I have quickened the beat.
Your knees strike the rubble.
That note was for the onlookers.
I raise a hand and the sound climbs.
You have fallen in the middle of the clearing.
I draw the sound back slowly.
You are still nodding to the beat.
The song is not finished.
I smile; the mask hides it.

lines.zh: 最后一拍落在了你身上。
lines.en: The final beat was struck on you.
I draw the final note out long.

lines.zh: 你被这一声按在了地上。
lines.en: That note presses you to the ground.
I raise a hand and cut off a shrill note.

lines.zh: 歌里忽然多了一段低鸣。
lines.en: A low drone has entered the song.

lines.zh: 两百点血，唱到最后一拍。
lines.en: Two hundred health, singing to the last beat.
There is one more singer in the clearing.
The originium begins to hum.
I step out of the echo.

lines.zh: 地上的碎屑排成了弧线。
lines.en: Debris on the ground forms an arc.

lines.zh: 第一个音落下，空气就凉了。
lines.en: The first note falls, and the air cools.
My robes trail across the gravel.
I lift my chin and begin to sing.
This place is good for harmony.
My mask catches the light in the dark.
The third sound you hear is me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过来，节拍不变。
lines.en: I walk over slowly, tempo unchanged.
Fire catches my hem and it smokes.
I hit the ground and the sound scatters.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，歌变成了气泡。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and the song becomes bubbles.

lines.zh: 爆炸声盖过了我的声音。
lines.en: The blast drowns out my voice.
Something cut a note short.
The originium resonates all through me.
I have sung too long and am running out of breath.
Thunder tears my song apart.

lines.zh: 我的声音没有地方回响。
lines.en: My voice has nowhere to echo.
